== Template:Gear/Slot ==

Displays a single equipment item with an optional quality indicator. The default [[MediaWiki:Gadget-item-tooltips.js|item-tooltips gadget]] opens the linked item's tooltip at that quality on hover or keyboard focus.

=== Parameters ===

{| class="wikitable"
! Parameter
! Description
|-
| <code>item</code> or <code>1</code>
| Item name. Used for the link target and image filename unless overridden.
|-
| <code>image</code>
| Image filename without an extension. Defaults to the item name.
|-
| <code>link</code>
| Link target. Defaults to the item name. The hover tooltip is loaded from this page.
|-
| <code>quality</code>
| Optional item quality. Supported values are <code>Blessed</code> and <code>Ascended</code>. The quality controls both the sparkle overlay and hover tooltip.
|}

=== Usage examples ===

==== Basic item ====

<pre>{{Gear/Slot|Warlord's Charm}}</pre>

{{Gear/Slot|Warlord's Charm}}

==== Blessed item ====

<pre>{{Gear/Slot|Sivakayan Tricorner|quality=Blessed}}</pre>

{{Gear/Slot|Sivakayan Tricorner|quality=Blessed}}

==== Item with a custom image ====

<pre>{{Gear/Slot|item=Rotten Hands|image=Rotten Hands.png|quality=Ascended}}</pre>

{{Gear/Slot|item=Rotten Hands|image=Rotten Hands.png|quality=Ascended}}

=== Technical notes ===

* Images are displayed at 60 by 60 pixels.
* <code>Blessed</code> uses <code>Blue_Sparkle.gif</code>. <code>Ascended</code> uses <code>Purple_Sparkle.gif</code>.
* An image supplied through <code>image</code> must include its extension.
* The original image link remains clickable when its tooltip is open.
